parameters.name: CasterId
parameters.description:
The production studio ID.
- If you created the production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, check the CasterId parameter returned by the CreateCaster operation.

- If you created the production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to **ApsaraVideo Live console** > **Production Studios** > **China Cloud Production Studio** to view the ID.

> The name of the production studio in the production studio list on the China Cloud Production Studio page is the production studio ID.

parameters.name: ComponentId
parameters.description:
The list of component IDs. The components are arranged in bottom-to-top order within the array. >N indicates the sequence number. For example:
ComponentId.1 indicates the first component ID.
ComponentId.2 indicates the second component ID.

parameters.name: LayoutId
parameters.description: The layout ID. If you call the [DescribeCasterLayouts](~~2848028~~) operation to query the layout list of a production studio, check the LayoutId parameter returned by the DescribeCasterLayouts operation.

parameters.name: SceneId
parameters.description: The scene ID. The scene must have been started by calling StartCasterScene. Otherwise, the IncorrectSceneStatus error is returned.
